usage: 屏幕 refers to the display part of electronic devices such as computers, phones, and TVs.
You can use 屏幕 to talk about the size, quality, or condition of a screen.
It often appears in compound words related to technology, such as touch screen (觸控屏幕).
When describing a screen, you can combine the word with adjectives to specify details, e.g., big screen or broken screen.
屏幕 is used in both formal and informal contexts when discussing devices or technology.
